    • ActionResult

      @Deprecated public ActionResult(boolean success, T value, Duration duration, List<ActionEvent> events, Optional<ActionFailure> failure)
      Deprecated.
      cannot represent dry-run or not-executed outcomes; prefer the canonical constructor or the explicit-execution-mode overload
      Compatibility constructor retained for the original click API.

      A plain success flag cannot distinguish ActionExecutionMode.REAL from ActionExecutionMode.DRY_RUN or ActionExecutionMode.NOT_EXECUTED, so a failure is never assumed to mean the backend was not invoked: this constructor always reports ActionExecutionMode.REAL, whether success is true or false. This is the fail-safe choice, since executed() returning true signals "already attempted, do not blindly retry" rather than "definitely completed"; an unattempted resolution or precondition failure incorrectly marked REAL would be far less dangerous than an actually-attempted failure incorrectly marked ActionExecutionMode.NOT_EXECUTED, which could invite an unsafe duplicate execution. Callers that know the true execution mode should use ActionResult(boolean, Object, Duration, List, Optional, ActionExecutionMode) or the canonical constructor instead.

    • success

    • dryRun

    • executed

      public boolean executed()
      Returns whether the backend action was actually invoked, regardless of whether the overall result succeeded.

      This is true whenever the pipeline reached backend execution at least once, which happens at most once per action. It remains true even when backend execution itself threw, since the backend call was genuinely made and a side effect may already have happened; it does not by itself certify that the side effect completed successfully — combine it with success() for that. It is false for a dry-run (dryRun()) and for any outcome decided before backend execution, such as a resolution or precondition failure.

    • toCompactText

      public String toCompactText()

    • decisionTrace

      public ActionDecisionTrace decisionTrace()
      Returns the ordered sequence of governed-execution decisions made while producing this result, derived lazily from events() on every call rather than stored - an ungoverned action never pays any cost for a trace it will never contain.

      Empty whenever no governed-execution policy was configured for this action, including for every value produced by one of this record's compatibility constructors: those never emit a ActionStage.POLICY_EVALUATION_COMPLETED event, so there is nothing to parse. A future event whose policy.* metadata this method cannot parse is skipped rather than thrown, so this method never crashes a caller that only wants the trace.
